changes.title: Rig live
items: Creatures on the ground now move with live animation: legs stepping on the ground, bodies leaning into turns and charges, crouching before a leap (add ?rig=0 to the address to see the old frames)
Legends always animate, even seen from the treetops
Party animals animate too, in their party gear, and enraged creatures keep their red eyes and red tint
Creatures' legs read as smooth limbs rather than strings of beads

changes.title: Home circle
items: Home's area is now a whole circle round the dancefloor reaching past the treehouse, so no neighbouring area cuts into it; the areas round it are shaped round it
Home is a meadow of its own: fresh green grass and wildflowers, no trees
Party decorations are scattered all over home instead: lanterns, balloons, chairs, tables, flower pots, stepping stones and more
At the start the ley line leaves from the front of the treehouse, heading south towards you, then curves round to the first stone

changes.title: Travel posse
items: Your animals keep out of trouble on long trips: far from you on the ground (or from their sigil) they travel quietly along the edges between areas, a little faster, and wild animals leave them be
Close to you on the ground, or near their sigil, they're your posse again and fight as before; they don't drop out mid-fight
While an animal travels, its leash becomes its route: a dotted line on the ground from it to you or its sigil, snaking along the area borders (easy to see from the treetops)
Only your posse eats berries: travellers don't stop for them

changes.title: Pixel wind
items: Leaves now sway in clumps, each bunch moving a whole step at a time, instead of smearing

changes.title: Invites
items: Invite with 💌s instead of chatting: on the ground, click (or hold 1) to throw a burst of spinning 💌s at the cursor; on a gamepad, aim with the right stick and throw with a trigger; on touch, the 💌 button throws them the way you're going
Each 💌 that lands fills a little meter of hearts over the creature (babies need a few, adults many); it drains slowly if you stop; full, the creature joins your party
A creature can only take one 💌's worth of affection every half second: a burst helps you invite a crowd, not one creature faster (the extra letters still land with a little ✨)
You call out with an emoji every time you throw, and the creature you hit answers, warming up as its meter fills
A creature's reply bubble is sized by its level: babies' smallest, legends' largest (yours stays the same)
Enraged creatures and legends block 💌s (they answer 😠); your own party animals let them through

Enraged creatures are tinted a soft red (easy to pick out, even from the treetops), wear angry brows over their red eyes and have a 💢 popping beside their heads; dazed ones see stars; happy ones wear party clothes without the glowing collar (that's for your party), and dance where there's a soundsystem; legends never dress up
Party animals, happy ones and your own, twinkle with a few little sparkles, so you can spot them in a crowd

changes.title: Blink
items: The dodge (W) is now a blink: she vanishes and reappears 10 m on the way she's going (or facing, if she's still), with a puff of motes where she left, a burst where she lands and a faint streak between
She can't be hit in the instant she's gone, and she never lands inside a tree, a rock, a soundsystem or the treehouse: the blink stops short at the last clear spot

changes.title: Berry cost
items: Evolving now costs 2 berries then 2 (was 1 then 3): still 4 from baby to adult, each berry buying the same strength. Berry patches are bigger, so there are more berries about

changes.title: Area flora
items: Every kind of wood now grows its own mix of three to six kinds of tree, in its own shades
Ten new trees: wild cherry in blossom, crab apple, elder, aspen, silvery whitebeam, field elm and flat-tiered cedar

Three magical ones, rarely and only where magic suits: glowing mushroom trees in the hazel rings, crystal-leaf trees by the cave mouth, and vine-hung trees with glowing buds in the old garden and the holly thicket
